rule.message:
Admission to the Computer Science major is a competitive process based on the successful completion of specific technical courses and a grade point average (GPA) based on technical courses (the technical GPA ).
Students who have completed the necessary technical courses and have a 3.2 or above technical GPA at the end of the semester will be guaranteed admission to that major. All other students who have completed the necessary technical coursework for their intended major (as identified by each department) will be considered for admission to that major on a space-available basis.
Students are eligible to apply once they have met the following minimum requirements for prerequisite courses and technical GPA.
Students must have completed or be currently enrolled in five specific courses with a grade of C- or better. Those courses are a calculus introductory core sequence (Calc I and Calc II), a course in discrete structures, and a computer science introductory core sequence (CS I option and CS II option).
For more information on the application to the major process for the Computer Science BS program, visit the CS&E Computer Science BA Application website . Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s  Liberal Education requirements .
All CLA BA degrees require 18 upper-division (3xxx-level or higher) credits outside the major designator. These credits must be taken in designators different from the major designator and cannot include courses that are cross-listed with the major designator. The major designator for the Computer Science BA is CSCI.
At least 12 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
Students may complete no more than one degree in the computer science program: a BA or a BS or a minor.
Students are required to complete 4 semester(s) of any second language, with a grade of C- or better, or S, or demonstrate proficiency in the language(s) as defined by the department or college.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) must complete the First-Year Experience course sequence.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) students earning a BA, BS, or BIS degree must complete CLA 3002 or another approved career or internship course (CLA 3101, CLA 3201, CLA 3301, CLA 3896, or CLA 3996.
All students must complete a capstone in at least one CLA major. The requirements for double majors completing the capstone in a different CLA major will be clearly stated. Students must also complete all major requirements in both majors to allow the additional capstone to be waived. Students completing an additional degree must complete the capstone in each degree area.
Sample plans are available for this program: https://sampleplan.umn.edu/node/391 Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Integrated Computer Science B.A./M.S. Program. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
